final: WITH item AS (SELECT ili.order_item_id AS oi, c.town_city AS town, AVG(ili.product_price) AS p, AVG(CASE WHEN ili.derived_total_cost IS NOT NULL AND ili.derived_product_cost IS NOT NULL THEN ili.derived_product_cost * 1.0 / ili.derived_total_cost END) AS r FROM Invoice_Line_Items ili JOIN Invoices i ON i.invoice_number = ili.invoice_number JOIN Orders o ON o.order_id = i.order_id JOIN Customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY ili.order_item_id, c.town_city), town AS (SELECT town, AVG(p) AS avg_price, AVG(r) AS avg_ratio FROM item GROUP BY town) SELECT town, avg_price, avg_ratio, avg_ratio - (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) FROM town) AS ratio_excess FROM town WHERE avg_ratio > (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) FROM town)
